title: Song - The God of Abraham Praise (simplified)

meta.trains: The God of Abraham Praise (tune "Leoni") in E minor, with a one-beat pickup, over one held block chord a bar in the left (Em, D, Bm, B, Am).
meta.composer: Traditional (Hebrew melody for the Yigdal, transcribed by Meyer Lyon; tune "Leoni")
departures: Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the chords of a beginner minor song only (Em, D, Bm, B, Am), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 72 instead of 88 quarter notes a minute.
The double bar lines the source prints inside the bars at the ends of phrases are left out: the music is written in whole 4/4 bars.
Written in E minor, the key the source sounds in (the source writes it in F minor and transposes it down a semitone).
